title: Measure the build system the way the owner asked
requested_outcome: On 2026-09-25 the owner agreed that the engineering system is judged by two measures: hours from asking to seeing the change on the phone, and minutes of the owner's attention per change (NEXT_PHASE_2026-09-25.md section 3.7). Build scripts/engineering_measures.py and app/engineering_measures.py (the logic, importable and tested) that produce those measures from records that already exist. Inputs: one or more loop status projections (the status.json the loops publish, with each request's id, submission time, stage timestamps, outcome and candidate SHA), the trunk history (the script runs git log on the first-parent history of clive/trunk itself, reading merge commits and their parents, so it can tell when each candidate SHA reached the trunk), an optional deploy log (JSON Lines of {sha, deployed_at}) and an optional owner-attention log (JSON Lines of {at, minutes, about}, where 'about' names a request id or a pull request). Output, as markdown and as JSON: per objective, the time from submission to completion, to landing in the trunk and, where a deploy covers it, to production; the number of review rounds; the owner minutes attributed to it; and totals and medians per day. Missing inputs make the related columns empty, never guessed. The logic takes parsed data, so tests in tests/test_engineering_measures.py use fixtures for status projections, merge histories (as parsed lists, not a live repository), deploy and attention logs, covering objectives that never landed, candidates landed through a later merge, and days without deploys. You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output, and the independent review returns its findings, to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: the two owner measures are computed per objective and per day from existing records
missing inputs leave columns empty rather than guessed
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
